messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR to tweak the frontend Deployment rollout and default replica settings for session-manager. Trying to reduce burst CPU during deploys and avoid flapping liveness checks. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/session-manager/pull/412

maria: Seen it. TL;DR of changes?

alex: Changing Deployment.strategy to RollingUpdate with maxSurge: 20% and maxUnavailable: 25%, minReadySeconds: 10. Also lowering default replicas from 6 -> 4 and adding podDisruptionBudget adjustment.

jin: Can you paste the Deployment snippet? want to eyeball probe config quickly.

alex: Sure — excerpt from the manifest:```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: session-manager
spec:
  replicas: 4
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 20%
      maxUnavailable: 25%
  minReadySeconds: 10
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: session-manager
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "250m"
            memory: "512Mi"
          limits:
            cpu: "1"
            memory: "1Gi"
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 10
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
```

maria: initialDelaySeconds 15 for liveness looks tight if app cold-starts >15s. We saw similar flaps in Canary last week. Suggest bumping to 30 and make readiness stricter.

sam: Also note: HPA is enabled for this service. If HPA is present, TF-managed replicas get overwritten at runtime. Check autoscaler target metrics before lowering replicas in TF.

alex: Good catch — HPA exists. I left replicas in k8s manifest as 4 but plan to put TF replicas change in a follow-up only if we decide to remove HPA. For now thinking to set pod minReplicas in HPA to 3 and target CPU 60%.

jin: If HPA minReplica is 3 and you set Deployment replicas 4, controller will reconcile to HPA values anyway. So either set Deployment replicas to HPA.min or let k8s default.

lee: On secrets wiring: the new config mounts a credentials secret for token rotation. If this is deployed in Dedicated, make sure the secret annotation points to the KMS key:```hcl
resource "kubernetes_secret" "session_token" {
  metadata {
    name = "session-token"
    annotations = {"kms.redwood.com/key" = var.kms_key_id}
  }
  data = { token = filebase64("./secrets/token.txt") }
}
```

alex: Thanks — I'll add the KMS annotation. Also added minReadySeconds because we observed ~8s warmup. Aim is reduce 429s on rollout.

maria: Regarding rollout strategy numbers: 20% surge + 25% unavailable seems odd because they can overlap and spike capacity. I'd prefer maxSurge: 1 (or 25%) and maxUnavailable: 0 for safer in-prod. What's the traffic pattern during deploys?

alex: Traffic is bursty but typically low for this service (internal sessions). We want to avoid big concurrency jumps leading to OOMs. Maybe set maxSurge: 1 and maxUnavailable: 25%?

sam: For safer path: maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0 plus increase readiness initialDelay. That avoids deleting old pods until new is ready.

jin: Also consider lowering container probe timeouts instead of initialDelay if checks are noisy. And set terminationGracePeriod to 60s so connections drain.

alex: Updated PR with suggested changes: maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0, liveness initialDelay 30, readiness initialDelay 10, terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60. PTAL @maria @jin @sam.

deploy-bot: canary started — deploying session-manager to canary pool (2 pods). Monitor: https://observability.internal/d/redwood/session-manager/canary

lee: I'll check KMS annotation flow and secrets rotation after canary finish.

maria: Quick code-review: left 2 small comments on PR (probe paths + PDB minAvailable). Should be quick.

alex: Thanks all. If no objections I plan full rollout tomorrow 03:00 UTC. cc @oncall

sam: +1 from infra side.

jin: +1, but watch memory usage during canary.

lee: Ready to approve once KMS annotation is in PR.

alex: will update now, thx :thumbsup:
